en: The image shows a black and white photograph of a fountain with three naked child statues standing in a circle, holding hands, with water streaming over them. The fountain is set in front of an arched structure with stucco walls and a tiled roof. There is a park bench to the left, and some trees are visible in the background. The architecture and style evoke early 20th-century European or American park design.
